journey.name: News Bulletin listener leak reproduction
journey.description: On the Pixel_6a emulator, open the first article and follow updates in three explicitly specified passages. Return to the same Home list after each passage.

actions.action: Verify that News Bulletin Home shows Community garden opens, Library adds evening hours, and Park trail restored.
Tap Community garden opens on Home for passage one.
Verify that the Article screen shows Community garden opens and the Follow updates button.
Tap Follow updates on the Article screen for passage one.
Verify that the Article screen shows Following updates for this article.
Press Back to return to Home from passage one.
Verify that Home shows Community garden opens, Library adds evening hours, and Park trail restored after passage one.
Tap Community garden opens on Home for passage two.
Verify that the Article screen shows Community garden opens and the Follow updates button.
Tap Follow updates on the Article screen for passage two.
Verify that the Article screen shows Following updates for this article.
Press Back to return to Home from passage two.
Verify that Home shows Community garden opens, Library adds evening hours, and Park trail restored after passage two.
Tap Community garden opens on Home for passage three.
Verify that the Article screen shows Community garden opens and the Follow updates button.
Tap Follow updates on the Article screen for passage three.
Verify that the Article screen shows Following updates for this article.
Press Back to return to Home from passage three.
Verify that Home shows Community garden opens, Library adds evening hours, and Park trail restored after passage three.
Tap About on Home.
Verify that the About screen shows About News Bulletin.
Press Back to return to Home from About.
Verify that Home shows Community garden opens, Library adds evening hours, and Park trail restored.
